name: ddrs
description: DDRS — Digital Drugs Regulatory System (CDSCO). Enterprise-grade regulatory platform.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "pnpm --filter backend start:dev" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.vercel-build: pnpm --filter backend build && node scripts/copy-wasm.js && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter backend lint && pnpm --filter frontend lint
